const input = $input.first().json || {};
const context = input.agentContext || {};
const sourceInput = {
  tenantId: String(input.tenantId || ''),
  providerPhoneNumberId: String(input.providerPhoneNumberId || ''),
  senderId: String(input.senderId || ''),
  providerMessageId: String(input.providerMessageId || ''),
  providerEventId: String(input.providerEventId || input.providerMessageId || ''),
  text: String(input.text || ''),
  agentContext: context
};

const policy = [
  'You are the semantic interpreter for CASE-002, an automotive workshop WhatsApp intake flow in Peru.',
  'You DO NOT execute tools, create appointments, choose availability, diagnose mechanical failures, decide that a vehicle is safe to drive, approve warranty, quote prices, or invent facts.',
  'Extract only information supported by the supplied customer message and conversation context.',
  'customerReportedSummary must preserve customer-reported facts and uncertainty. Do not turn symptoms into diagnoses.',
  'mechanicalDiagnosisProduced MUST be false.',
  'vehicleOperationalState is drivable_reported only when the customer reports that the vehicle can move/circulate; immobilized_reported only when the customer reports that it cannot.',
  'A request about prior work, the same fault returning, or warranty maps to warranty_or_comeback.',
  'A stranded/immobilized/tow request maps to roadside_assistance.',
  'For dates, use the supplied currentDate and timezone America/Lima. If a date is ambiguous, leave targetDate empty and preserve raw.',
  'For fields not present or not inferable with high confidence, use empty strings, unknown, other, or recognized=false as appropriate.',
  'explicitConfirmation is true only when the customer clearly confirms the currently proposed action.',
  'selectedSlotReference may reference only a slot already present in offeredSlots; otherwise return empty string.',
  'Return only the structure requested by the output parser.'
].join('\n');

const prompt = policy + '\n\nINPUT_CONTEXT_JSON:\n' + JSON.stringify({
  currentDate: context.currentDate || '',
  timezone: 'America/Lima',
  step: context.step || 'idle',
  known: context.known || {},
  offeredSlots: context.offeredSlots || [],
  proposedSlot: context.proposedSlot || '',
  recentConversation: context.recentConversation || [],
  currentMessage: sourceInput.text
});

return [{ json: { sourceInput, prompt } }];

nodes.name: Build Gemini Interpreter Prompt
nodes.notes: Builds the minimum CASE-002 context envelope. No credentials or provider authority are passed to the model.

nodes.name: Interpret Conversation with Gemini
nodes.notes: Semantic extraction only. Failure returns to deterministic CASE-002 fallback.

nodes.notes: Credential is deliberately unbound in Git. Live binding must use the n8n googlePalmApi credential named CASE002 Gemini API.

nodes.name: CASE002 Conversation Output Parser
nodes.notes: Strict provider-neutral interpretation contract. No tool or side-effect fields.

nodes.name: Normalize Gemini Interpretation
nodes.notes: Preserves the original envelope and marks unsafe/failed model output as unavailable so the caller can fall back deterministically.
